d: Eerie vocalisations echoing through pitch-black timber, massive footprints pressed into remote mud, and unexplained heat signatures moving just beyond the flashlight beam- something massive is roaming North America’s deepest woods. This Season 2 compilation of finding Bigfoot gathers the top investigations, most compelling clues, and unforgettable Bigfoot encounters across Episodes 7, 2, 10, 1, 3, 6, and 5.
